---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      .default = "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
world_map <- map_data("world") |>
  mutate(region = str_to_lower(region))

attack_counts <- attacks |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = case_match(
      Country_lower,
      "usa" ~ "usa",
      "united kingdom" ~ "uk",
      "england" ~ "uk",
      "scotland" ~ "uk",
      "columbia" ~ "colombia",
      "reunion" ~ "reunion",
      "reunion island" ~ "reunion",
      "andaman / nicobar islandas" ~ "india",
      "azores" ~ "portugal",
      "british isles" ~ "uk",
      "british virgin islands" ~ "virgin islands",
      "federated states of micronesia" ~ "micronesia",
      "grand cayman" ~ "cayman islands",
      "maldive islands" ~ "maldives",
      "san domingo" ~ "dominican republic",
      "st. maartin" ~ "saint martin",
      "st. martin" ~ "saint martin",
      "united arab emirates (uae)" ~ "united arab emirates",
      "western samoa" ~ "samoa",
      .default = Country_lower
    )
  ) |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "n")

world_map |>
  left_join(attack_counts, by = c("region" = "Country_lower")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = n)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey90", name = "Attacks") +
  labs(
    title = "Shark attacks by country",
    subtitle = "Reported attacks in the cleaned dataset",
    caption = "Grey indicates map regions without a matching country name."
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
